test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many languages are declared as classical languages by the Government of India as of March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of March 2022, the Government of India has declared **six languages as classical languages.**
 
• The** Ministry of Culture, Government of India**, is responsible for conferring the Classical Language status.
 
• The **University Grants Commission (UGC) **provides financial assistance for setting up centers for the study of these languages.
 
• High antiquity of its early **texts/recorded history** over a period of **1500-2000 years** is the criteria for declaring a language as a Classical Language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil**: Declared as a Classical Language in 2004 (first language to get the status).
 
• **Sanskrit**: Declared in 2005.
 
• **Kannada**: Declared in 2008.
 
• **Telugu**: Declared in 2008.
 
• **Malayalam**: Declared in 2013.
 
• **Odia**: Declared in 2014.
